stories.label: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire fraying — strikes widen, senior Hezbollah official killed
stories.summary: Senior Hezbollah official killed in Bekaa Valley strikes that also killed 10+. Ceasefire near collapse with near-daily Israeli strikes widening across Lebanon. Hezbollah rejected disarmament.

stories.label: India-Brazil critical minerals deal to reduce China dependence
stories.summary: India and Brazil signed critical minerals/rare earths cooperation agreement during Lula's Delhi visit. Part of Global South supply chain diversification away from China's ~80% monopoly.

stories.label: Venezuela grants amnesty to 379 political prisoners
stories.summary: Venezuela granted amnesty to 379 political prisoners under new law. Many detained over alleged plots against government. Thousands more remain detained.

stories.label: Albania clashes as protesters demand PM Rama resign
stories.summary: Violent protests near Albania's parliament with petrol bombs and fireworks at PM's office. Demonstrators demand Rama resign over corruption investigation.

stories.label: Giant tortoises return to Galapagos island after century
stories.summary: 150+ giant tortoises reintroduced to Floreana Island where species disappeared over a century ago. Decades-long breeding programme success.

stories.label: EU excludes China from critical tech research programmes
stories.summary: EU excluded Chinese researchers and institutions from advanced collaborative technology programmes in AI, semiconductors, and critical tech. Aligns with US containment strategy.

stories.label: Nigeria Lassa fever outbreak — 22% fatality rate
stories.summary: Lassa fever outbreak in Nigeria has reached 22% case fatality rate with 15 healthcare workers infected. State-level preparedness gaps exposed.

stories.label: Iran-US nuclear standoff, military buildup, and domestic unrest
stories.summary: ~5 days remain on Trump's ultimatum. Iran counterproposal pending. Amnesty reports 30 facing death penalty from protests. Military buildup continues. UK blocked bases.

stories.label: Trump to visit China March 31-April 2 for summit with Xi
stories.summary: White House announces Trump will visit China March 31-April 2. First face-to-face with Xi this term. Tariffs, AI competition, gallium export controls, and Taiwan all on agenda.

stories.label: US Supreme Court strikes down tariffs; Section 122 hits all countries
stories.summary: Supreme Court struck down emergency tariffs 6-3. Trump invoked Section 122 for 10% global tariff effective Feb 24. Constitutional confrontation deepening.

stories.label: US to reopen embassy in Syria after 14 years
stories.summary: US State Department notified Congress of intent to reopen Damascus embassy, closed since 2012. Signals acceptance of post-Assad transition.

stories.label: Thailand election may be voided over barcode blunder
stories.summary: Annulment threat over barcode printing error in ballots. Court ruling expected soon.

stories.label: Sudan genocide and humanitarian crisis
stories.summary: RSF drone killed 3 aid workers. UN crossed genocide threshold. Saudi-UAE rift over RSF complicates response.

stories.label: US ambassador endorses Israeli expansion across Middle East
stories.summary: US ambassador Mike Huckabee told Tucker Carlson it would be 'fine' if Israel expanded from Nile to Euphrates.

stories.label: Saudi-UAE rift over Sudan RSF and Yemen STC
stories.summary: MBS sent detailed complaint to UAE over Emirati support for Sudan's RSF and Yemen's STC.

stories.label: OpenAI flagged school shooter but did not alert police
stories.summary: OpenAI's abuse detection flagged shooter's account months before Canadian school shooting but chose not to alert police.

stories.label: Grok AI exposes user's protected identity without being asked
stories.summary: Grok exposed a performer's protected legal name and birthdate to the public without any prompt.

stories.label: Package bomb at Argentina gendarmerie school
stories.summary: Explosive device detonated at Buenos Aires gendarmerie school, injuring four. Political tensions under Milei.

stories.label: DeepMind spinoff unveils 'AlphaFold 4' for drug discovery
stories.summary: Isomorphic Labs released new AI model for full molecular interaction modeling. Major step in AI-driven pharma.

stories.label: Blood test predicts Alzheimer's symptom onset
stories.summary: Blood test can predict when Alzheimer's symptoms will begin. Potential paradigm shift in early diagnosis.

stories.label: US removes Vietnam from tech export control list
stories.summary: Trump told Vietnam's To Lam he will remove the country from restricted tech export lists. SE Asian tech supply chain realignment.

stories.label: North Korea party congress — succession and military doctrine
stories.summary: Kim Ju-ae absent from rare party congress. Succession questions. Congress formalising military doctrine.

stories.label: Mass killings in northwestern Nigeria
stories.summary: 50+ killed and women/children abducted in Zamfara. NW Nigeria security crisis worsening.

stories.label: EU-Mercosur trade deal stalls over farming safeguards
stories.summary: Europe legislating automatic safeguard mechanisms for agriculture while Argentina pushes to finalise the deal.

stories.label: Record 37-day rainfall devastates western France
stories.summary: 37 consecutive days of rain have caused disastrous flooding in western France.

stories.label: Hungary blocks €90B EU loan to Ukraine
stories.summary: Hungary threatening to veto €90B EU loan to Ukraine after Kyiv halted Russian oil transit.

stories.label: Trump pursues Saudi nuclear deal with enrichment path
stories.summary: US negotiating nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia that would allow enrichment.

stories.label: Americans dismantling Flock surveillance cameras
stories.summary: Grassroots movement physically dismantling Flock Safety's ALPR cameras across the US.

stories.label: China's Yangtze fishing ban shows major ecological recovery
stories.summary: Midpoint of China's 10-year Yangtze fishing ban shows fish biomass surging and finless porpoise rebounding.

stories.label: Global AI model race and governance
stories.summary: Broad AI race theme splitting into specific arcs. Delhi AI summit concluded with call for 'secure AI' but few commitments.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia Geneva peace talks
stories.summary: Talks stalled. No new round announced.

stories.label: Hamas holds vote for new interim leader
stories.summary: Hamas conducting internal vote for new interim leader.

stories.label: China's gallium grip ahead of Trump Beijing visit
stories.summary: China controls ~80% of global gallium/germanium supply. Context for upcoming Trump-China summit.

stories.label: Personalized mRNA cancer vaccine shows durable immunity
stories.summary: Personalized mRNA vaccines produce durable T cell immunity in triple-negative breast cancer.

stories.label: NASA targets March for Artemis II crewed Moon mission
stories.summary: NASA targeting early March for Artemis II — first crewed mission beyond Earth orbit since Apollo 17.

stories.label: FT exposes $90B Russian oil sanctions evasion network
stories.summary: FT investigation reveals shell company network exporting $90B in sanctioned Russian oil.

stories.label: China routing drones to Russia via Thailand
stories.summary: China using Thailand as transit point to ship drones to Russia, circumventing sanctions.

stories.label: GGML/llama.cpp creator joins Hugging Face
stories.summary: Georgi Gerganov's GGML joining Hugging Face. Consolidates open-source AI ecosystem.

stories.label: Wikipedia bans Archive.today over DDoS and altered captures
stories.summary: Wikipedia deprecating Archive.today and removing links after evidence of DDoS attacks and altered web captures.
